[EN] The fundamental materials when etching are {@RawItem:206818}, {@RawItem:206819}, and {@RawItem:206820}. You can gather {@RawItem:206818} from a Crimson Essence, {@RawItem:206819} from an Earth Essence, and {@RawItem:206820} from an Azure Essence. Go to Activities - Gather in the Achievement menu for details. First, collect the following materials, and then I'll teach you the basics of etching.

{@RawItem:206818} ×5
{@RawItem:206819} ×5
{@RawItem:206820} x5
[ES] Los materiales fundamentales para el Etching son {@RawItem:206818}, {@RawItem:206819} y {@RawItem:206820}. Puedes recolectar {@RawItem:206818} de una Crimson Essence, {@RawItem:206819} de una Earth Essence y {@RawItem:206820} de una Azure Essence. Ve a Actividades - Recolectar en el menú de Logros para obtener detalles. Primero, recolecta los siguientes materiales y luego te enseñaré los fundamentos del Etching.

{@RawItem:206818} ×5
{@RawItem:206819} ×5
{@RawItem:206820} x5

[EN] Good job.
These are the most basic materials for etching. Now, let's get you a design to get started!
[ES] Buen trabajo.
Estos son los materiales más básicos para el Etching. ¡Ahora, vamos a conseguirte un diseño para empezar!

[EN] You won't get anywhere by sitting still. Get moving!
[ES] No llegarás a ninguna parte quedándote sentado. ¡Ponte en marcha!
